list_inference_endpoints: list all Inference Endpoints for a given namespace using the hf endpoints ls command
deploy_inference_endpoint: deploy an Inference Endpoint from a Hub repository with specified framework, accelerator, and instance settings
deploy_from_catalog: deploy an Inference Endpoint from the Hugging Face Model Catalog with a given repo and accelerator
update_inference_endpoint: update an existing Inference Endpoint configuration including replicas, scaling, and model revision
pause_resume_inference_endpoint: pause and resume an Inference Endpoint to control its running state and scale to zero
